fixtureContract.purpose: test-only typed domain constructors; never expose arbitrary fixture patches through production create/input
fixtureContract.timeUnit: logical milliseconds; advanceToMs executes all scheduled steps up to target inclusive
fixtureContract.stepOrder: same timestamp events use list order; simulation runs at explicit advanceToMs; no ambient wall clock
fixtureContract.domainEvent: test a lower domain directly with resolved typed facts; not a production command
fixtureContract.assertionPaths: semantic observations returned by scenario adapter, not a required World field layout
fixtureContract.fixtureOverrides: dotted paths replace fixture facts before execution, not runtime patches
fixtureContract.domainEventIdentity: when item has eventId, use it; otherwise derive stable scenarioId/stepIndex; repeatDomainEvent reuses identity
